Lamia leader. Upper torso and head of a naked woman, brightly scaled giant viper lower half. Arrogant, takes humanoid mates, then kills them.

AC 12 (leather), HP 37, ATK 2 scimitar +5 (1d6) and 1 touch +5 (drain wisdom) and 1 spell +5, MV double near, S +2, D +1, C +1, I +2, W +2, Ch +3, AL C, LV 8

Drain Wisdom. Target loses 1d4 WIS permanently.

Hateful Word (CHA Spell). DC 13. 4d4 damage to one creature that can hear within double near.

Summon Snake (CHA Spell). DC 13. Summon a giant constrictor that appears within near. It disappears in 1d4 rounds.

Vanish (CHA Spell). DC 13. Self. Become invisible for 1d4 rounds.
